text: v1.0.108 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.108 (on-screen engine reads 2.5x slower on a low-RAM device). Audit finding so far: with the GitHub engine driving, the tablet was still logging, grading and looking up closes for every listed bet (the scan study) and the engine already does that. v1.0.109 removes it, building next. Continuing through the rest of the tablet-side work (live lane, bid desk, recorders).
